[[Korsin]] '''Immera''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] woman and one of the commander of the [[Korsinite League]] on the [[3000 BBY]] and she came to [[Tahv]] to take part to the [[Testament Day]] and to stop the plan of the [[Sisters of Seelah]].
